operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Ceasefire-Period Toll in Gaza Reaches 1,610 as Drone Strike Wounds Four Near Jabalia
heroSubtitle: On Nov 8, 2026, five Palestinians were wounded across Gaza, including four in a drone strike at Bir al-Naaja west of Jabalia; Gaza's Health Ministry puts the toll since the October 2025 ceasefire at 1,610 killed and 5,819 wounded. Earlier, on Nov 7, rains flooded the tents of thousands of displaced families. On Nov 5, Israeli fire killed at least four Palestinians in Deir el-Balah, Bureij and Khan Younis; the cumulative toll since Oct 2023 stands above 74,000.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Palestine Chronicle, UN News, Arab News, Al-Monitor, Jerusalem Post, UPI, VINnews, RTE, Anadolu Agency, France 24, Irish Times, Middle East Monitor, World Bank. Gaza death toll: 73,914+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023; 1,394+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire. Day 1076 (Sep 21): Israeli tank fire on displaced-persons' tents in the al-Mawasi 'safe zone' west of Khan Younis kills 11-year-old Ismail al-Bardawil; an Israeli drone kills Mohsen Ahmed Bahjat in Jabalia; tank fire kills 31-year-old Fidaa Toutah on Salah al-Din Street east of Nuseirat as she returns from taking her children to school; a separate drone strike kills an unnamed man in Khan Younis city center hours later; 9 more wounded transported from Khan Younis and Bureij. Ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,394 killed, 4,839 wounded; cumulative toll reaches 73,914 killed — 347th consecutive ceasefire-violation day. Day 1075 (Sep 20): IDF/Shin Bet disclose killing three Hamas operatives over the weekend — Hamdouna, Rafa'i, and Basir al-Barsh (named a Nukhba commander), matching Basir al-Bursh, son of Health Ministry chief Munir al-Bursh, whose family disputes the militant claim; 2 more wounded near Khan Younis; ceasefire toll reaches 1,393 killed, 4,822 wounded. Day 1074 (Sep 19): drone strike kills Basir al-Bursh (28) in Jabalia's az-Zahra while he fills water containers; separate drone strike on a vehicle in Sheikh Radwan, Gaza City, kills Mohammad Khaled al-Refa'ey (24) and wounds 4+; a Shujaiya strike kills 1 more; a girl dies of Friday's gunfire wounds near Nuseirat. Day 1073 (Sep 18): Israeli soldiers shoot and kill Karam Mus'ad al-Masar'a on Julis Street, Nuseirat refugee camp; two more wounded near Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis — 344th consecutive ceasefire-violation day. Day 1072 (Sep 17): drone strikes kill Youssef al-Zaim (17th Roundabout, Gaza City) and Mohammad Nasser Suleiman al-Bayouk (Nahr al-Bared, Khan Younis); Ad-Daraj School and Sheikh Ajlin strikes wound ~12; Sa'id Barham dies of earlier wounds; IDF discloses killing Nukhba operative Eid (Bureij) and naval-force cmdr Miqdad (Gaza City); 5 killed, 28 wounded strip-wide, ceasefire toll reaches 1,386 killed, 4,784 wounded. Day 1062 (Sep 7): Israeli strikes kill 5 across Gaza incl. 2 children (Rimal drone strike, Aqila family vehicle strike, Sakina School artillery strike in Deir al-Balah); IDF discloses killing PIJ operative al-Batrihi (Shati camp) and Hamas Nukhba member Khalas, plus a mid-air munition diversion to avoid civilians; Kushner says Israel's government is acting 'a little irrational' on Gaza ahead of its election. Day 1061 (Sep 6): Strike kills 2 incl. a girl in Al-Nasr; mass funeral for 100 (incl. 60 children) recovered from Zeitoun rubble; 8 Muslim-majority nations warn of 'grave consequences' over Katz/Ben Gvir displacement plans; Netanyahu admits bombing Qatar. Day 1060 (Sep 5): 55 Malka family remains recovered from Zeitoun rubble; new Freedom Flotilla sets sail. Day 1059 (Sep 4): US State Dept rejects Israeli Gaza-displacement plans. Day 1058 (Sep 3): Rimal drone strike kills 13-yr-old; IDF kills 2 crossing Yellow Line near Beit Lahia; Ben Gvir unveils 'Disengagement 710' plan. Day 1057 (Sep 2): Katz says Israel is 'organised and prepared' to remove Gaza's population once Trump approves; Israeli drone strike/gunfire kills 2 in Jabalia; Health Ministry reports 8 killed, 31 wounded in 24 hrs. Day 1056 (Sep 1): Shin Bet raid in Al Katiba, Gaza City captures Hamas internal security chief Muein al-Arabid; covering IAF strikes kill 3, wound 8; separate strikes kill 4+ more including children. Day 1055 (Aug 31): Israeli drone strikes kill 5 in Gaza City — 2 near the municipal park (residential building entrance) and 3 in a Tal al-Hawa vehicle strike; IDF says both hit Qassam Brigades operatives; UN's Dujarric voices concern over continued airstrikes' civilian impact. Day 1054 (Aug 30): IDF kills Nukhba cmdr Mazloum and sniper Deiri in northern Gaza; separate Deir al-Balah strike kills operative Nasir and 3-yr-old Tayyem Hamdan. Day 1053 (Aug 29): Strikes kill 6+ across Gaza City, Khan Younis, al-Musaddar, Jabalia incl. Nukhba cmdr Abu al-Eish and 2 more Nukhba members; Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital supply tent struck a 2nd time in a month, wounding 3. Day 1052 (Aug 28): Strikes kill 5 — 3 from Abdeen family north of Khan Younis, 2 more in Sabra/Mashahra, Gaza City; IDF claims (no evidence) killing operative Bitawi and 2 Hamas/PIJ commanders. Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Palestine Chronicle, UN News, Arab News, Al-Monitor, Jerusalem Post, UPI. Gaza death toll: 73,419+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023; 1,285+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire. Day 1048 (Aug 24): IDF strikes kill 2 Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah, 1 an Oct 7 Nukhba fighter. Day 1047 (Aug 23): Netanyahu/Katz threaten intensified strikes over Gaza kites near Nahal Oz; IAF kills Hamas cmdr Abu Ful in Maghazi and a 4-yr-old in Az-Zawayda near an aid site; Khan Younis shelled along Yellow Line; Israel raises disarmament concerns. Day 1046 (Aug 22): Drone strike kills Hamas Deir al-Balah Battalion cmdr Sharif al-Hasanat; Hamas says not obligated to implement Trump deal without Israeli acceptance. Day 1045 (Aug 21): Poland summons Israeli ambassador over dropped WCK probe; IDF shoots Palestinian crossing Yellow Line in southern Gaza. Day 1044 (Aug 20): Mass funeral in Gaza City for 50 Palestinians (19 children) recovered from Dec 2023 strike rubble; Australia anger over dropped WCK case. Day 965 (Jun 2): IDF drones strike Jabalia, Al-Zawayda, Al-Bureij; 2 killed, 40 wounded in 24-hr period; new Mossad chief Gofman takes over; AP analysis confirms ceasefire hollow — Israel controls 60% of Gaza, Phase 2 paralyzed. Day 964 (Jun 1): IDF strikes continue; Hamas warns dangerous escalation. Day 963 (May 31): Apache strike Gaza seaport cafe — 2 killed, 12 wounded. Day 962 (May 30): Israeli strike kills Palestinian doctor, wounds 3. Day 961 (May 29): Netanyahu 70% Gaza directive. Day 960 (May 28): IDF strikes Gaza City residential building — 10 killed including 4 children. UNRWA staff killed: 397.
